attBesluta.text: I bought two of these for both of my garage doors, seeing as I use my two car garage as my woodworking shop, I want to seal as much of it up as possible with winter coming, these are great seals, I would highly recommend using the included screws because the double sided tape is for sure not strong enough on it's own. Make sure you clean up where you plan on attachng it too, just soap and water and let it dry completely before trying to stick it one, but once you have it where you need it, then start to secure it with the screws. Works great at sealing up and closing off the gaps.
Finally installed the Vevor garage door seal. It was so easy to install and it works really well by stopping dirt and dust entering the garage

I've been using this combination whiteboard for a few weeks now and I'm really impressed. It's perfect for both my home office and my kitchen - I use one for work notes and project planning, and the other for family schedules and shopping lists. The quality is top-notch, the installation is a breeze and it looks really stylish. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a versatile, good-quality notice board!
